Qt for Python / PySide6 Third-Party Software Notices
====================================================

This release bundles Qt for Python components including PySide6, shiboken6,
PySide6_Essentials, and PySide6_Addons.

Bundled versions:
- PySide6 6.11.1
- shiboken6 6.11.1
- PySide6_Essentials 6.11.1
- PySide6_Addons 6.11.1

Qt for Python contains or adapts some source material that is licensed by its
original authors under separate open-source license terms. Only the licenses
of third-party components actually shipped with MyWB apply to this release.

Full Qt for Python third-party notices are published by The Qt Company at:
https://doc.qt.io/qtforpython-6/licenses.html

The Python Software Foundation license text referenced by Qt for Python is
also included in this release at:
third_party/python/LICENSE.txt
